rv.q: Miller is an absolute powerhouse on stage, singing and acting with a level of commitment that I can best describe as spiritual possession.
Animal Wisdom will take you farther than you've been before, and you won't even be in a church.

The first half is filled with a hodgepodge of random observations. We’re told that you must not verbally deny a ghost that you know is in the room; Coca-Cola works better than sacramental wine, and “what they don’t tell you about dying is that you lose chronology.
There's a muchness to Animal Wisdom that is both admirable and daunting.
